name: Guangdong AVCiT Technology Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong AVCiT Technology Holding Co., Ltd. is dedicated to the global development, manufacturing, and sale of internet protocol-based video wall and KVM (Keyboard, Video, Mouse) solutions, primarily serving critical command and control environments. Their product range includes the DSII node, which functions as a video encoder and decoder, enabling the transmission of Full HD or 4K video over standard 1 Gigabit network infrastructure. For IP-based KVM needs, the company offers the DSIII, an encoder/decoder designed to relay FHD or UHD video and HID (Human Interface Device) signals across standard Gigabit Ethernet. Additionally, they provide the Phinx KVM matrix system, along with modular video wall matrix switches featuring chassis and customizable input/output cards. The company's offerings also extend to E-CP4C controllers, as well as DS3.0 operation and maintenance systems and user logging solutions. These advanced technologies are widely applied across various sectors, including transportation, public safety, finance, telecommunications, and energy/utilities. Founded in 2010, the firm's main offices are located in Guangzhou, China.
